Install a package a study needs, or say how

Source: R/study_need.R
study_need.Rd

Called where a function needs a package the study may not have, such as arrow for registered data. In the study's active renv project the packages are declared (see study_declare); a missing one is installed into the study's library after one question, when the session is interactive, and recorded in renv.lock. Otherwise the call stops and names hvtiR::setup(), which installs everything a study needs.

Nothing is declared until every package is installed: if the user declines the install, or it fails, the study's DESCRIPTION is left as it was.

An installed package is never upgraded, whatever its version: moving a study's package versions is hvtiR::update()'s job.

Usage

study_need(
  packages,
  root = NULL,
  caller = "study_need",
  note = NULL,
  only_in_renv = FALSE,
  r_upgrade = FALSE
)

Arguments

packages

Character. Package names.

root

Character(1). The study root; by default the study enclosing the working directory, if any.

caller

Character(1). The function that needs the packages, named in the question and the error.

note

Character(1) or NULL. Appended to the error.

only_in_renv

Logical(1). Do nothing outside an active renv study.

r_upgrade

Logical(1). Leave FALSE. The renv.lock snapshot that follows an install is refused from an R whose major.minor differs from the R the lockfile records (see guard_snapshot). Set TRUE only when you are deliberately moving the study to this session's R.

Value

The names of the packages installed, invisibly.

Examples

# Nothing to install, and nothing written, outside a study:
study_need("stats")
